properties.notes: “Redevelopment of the site involving the demolition of the existing garage buildings and adjacent boundary wall and erection of a terrace of five 2-storey plus basement mews houses (3-bedrooms) and one detached house (4-bedroom) together with associated parking, landscaping and pedestrian and vehicular accesses from Walcot Square; alterations to boundary treatments, including the erection of new boundary walls and reconstruction of part of the boundary wall to 1-7 Walcot Square.
